trace.notes: Normalized the single URL source https://zbmath.org/3801043 as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL.

The zbMATH web page did not expose readable full text through the available web reader and the web interface fetch returned 403 locally. The zbMATH API document endpoint identified the exact record as Silviu Sburlan, "Some open problems of finite elastic equilibrium," serial article, year 1983, source "Applied nonlinear functionalanalysis, variational methods and ill-posed problems, Proc. Workshop, Berlin 1981, Meth. Verf. Math. Phys. 25, 271-287 (1983)." The API record exposed no DOI and links=[].

Identifier-specific and exact-work recovery used the zbMATH ID/Zbl number, the exact title, exact title plus PDF, author plus exact title, and the proceedings/source citation. No readable primary PDF or full HTML artifact for the exact work was recovered, so no document map was constructed.

No candidates were extracted because the only recovered content was resolver metadata, bibliographic listings, citation snippets, and reference-list mentions. The source adequacy gate forbids extracting open problems from those materials.
